subject: C Programming & Systems Fundamentals
board: WBCHSE / ICSE / CBSE / BCA / B.Tech / Gate

projects.title: Text Anagram & Phrase Palindrome Verifier
projects.description: Write a C program that checks if two words are anagrams and whether a phrase with spaces and punctuation is a palindrome.
projects.exampleText: Words: 'Listen' vs 'Silent', Phrase: 'A man, a plan, a canal: Panama'
projects.exampleOutput:
Anagram Check: YES (Anagrams)
Palindrome Check: YES (Palindrome)
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Maintain 26-element frequency count for anagram checking.
2. Use two-pointer scan skipping non-alphanumeric characters for phrase palindrome verification.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates case normalization, character filtering via <ctype.h>, and symmetric two-pointer array scanning.

projects.title: Custom String Library Suite
projects.description: Re-implement strlen, strcpy, strcat, and strcmp from scratch using pure pointer arithmetic without including <string.h>.
projects.exampleOutput:
Result Buffer: 'Coder & AccoTax, Barrackpore'
Length: 28
Comparison: -1
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Pointer dereferencing and incrementation until '\0' byte.
2. Proper return pointer mechanics and null termination.
projects.codeExplanation: Implements core systems utilities using idiomatic C pointer syntax.

projects.title: Word Frequency, Vowel, Consonant & Digit Analyzer
projects.description: Parse a paragraph string and count the number of words, vowels, consonants, digits, whitespace, and special symbols.
projects.exampleText: Input: 'Barrackpore Pin Code is 700120! Learning C Language in 2026.'
projects.exampleOutput: Words: 10, Vowels: 17, Consonants: 22, Digits: 10, Spaces: 9, Special: 2
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Character categorization using isalpha, isdigit, isspace.
2. State variable inWord tracking word transition boundaries.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates text parsing, state machines, and character classification in C.

projects.title: Caesar Cipher Encryption & Decryption Engine
projects.description: Encrypt and decrypt confidential text messages by cyclically shifting alphabetic characters by K positions.
projects.exampleText: Message: 'Attack at Dawn from Barrackpore!', Shift: 3
projects.exampleOutput:
Encrypted Cipher : 'Dwwdfn dw Gdzq iurp Eduudfnsruh!'
Decrypted Plain  : 'Attack at Dawn from Barrackpore!'
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Modulo 26 cyclic arithmetic for uppercase ('A' to 'Z') and lowercase ('a' to 'z').
2. Decrypt by shifting with (26 - shift % 26).
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates cryptographic substitution algorithms, ASCII normalization, and wraparound modulo arithmetic.

projects.title: Run-Length String Compression Engine
projects.description: Compress repeating sequences of characters in a string into character-count pairs (e.g. 'wwwwaaadexxxxxxywww' -> 'w4a3d1e1x6y1w3').
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Count consecutive identical characters in a while loop.
2. Format character and count into destination buffer using sprintf.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates lossless compression algorithms and bounded string formatting.

projects.title: Substring Find and Replace Engine
projects.description: Replace all occurrences of a target substring with a replacement string in an input text paragraph.
projects.exampleText: Text: 'The student lives in Naihati. The student studies at Barrackpore.', Find: 'The student', Replace: 'Swadeep'
projects.exampleOutput: Replaced Text: 'Swadeep lives in Naihati. Swadeep studies at Barrackpore.'
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Use strncmp to detect substring matches.
2. Copy replacement string and advance source pointer accordingly.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates complex string memory copying, offset math, and pattern replacement.

projects.title: Longest Word Extractor from Text Paragraph
projects.description: Find and extract the longest word from a sentence and report its length.
projects.exampleText: Paragraph: 'Mastering C systems programming and architectural memory layouts in Barrackpore.'
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Track word boundaries (start and current length) using isalnum.
2. Update maxLen and maxStart when word exceeds previous record.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates word tokenization and substring extraction via strncpy.

projects.title: Password Strength & Complexity Evaluator
projects.description: Evaluate password security based on length >= 8, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special symbols.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Iterate characters checking boolean flags for uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special symbols.
2. Compute score out of 5.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates character property evaluation for security verification.

projects.title: Lexicographical Dictionary Sorter for Names
projects.description: Sort an array of student names in alphabetical order using strcmp and O(1) pointer swaps.
projects.exampleText: Names: ['Tuhina Paul', 'Swadeep Mukherjee', 'Abhronila Das', 'Debangshu Roy', 'Arindam Hui']
projects.exampleOutput: 1. Abhronila Das, 2. Arindam Hui, 3. Debangshu Roy, 4. Swadeep Mukherjee, 5. Tuhina Paul
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Compare names with strcmp.
2. Swap 8-byte pointer addresses directly to avoid buffer copying.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates high-performance pointer sorting on string collections.

projects.title: Roman Numerals to Decimal Integer Converter
projects.description: Convert Roman numeral strings (e.g. 'MCMXCIV') to standard decimal integers (1994).
projects.exampleOutput:
Roman XIV = 14
Roman MCMXCIV = 1994
Roman MMXXVI = 2026
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Map Roman chars to values (I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000).
2. If current value < next value, subtract current from next (e.g. IV = 4); else add.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates parsing subtraction rules in historical numbering systems.
